question: Priyanka Nutakki is related to which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Priyanka Nutakki** is an Indian chess player.
 
• In **2022**, she was awarded the FIDE title of **Woman Grandmaster** (WGM).
 
• Chess is a **board game** played between two players on a checkered board.
 
• It is a popular game worldwide and is recognized as a sport by the** International Olympic Committee.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey** is a team sport played on a field with a **stick and a ball**.

 
 
• It is a popular sport in countries like** India, Pakistan, and Australia.**
 
 
 
• **Badminton** is a** racquet sport** played on a court with a shuttlecock.
 
 
• It is a popular sport in countries like** China, Indonesia, and India.**
 
 
 
• **Wrestling** is a** combat **sport involving grappling techniques.
 
 
• It is a popular sport in countries like the **United States, Russia, and Iran.**
